name: textsearch_intl
abstract: Multilingual full text search: ICU word segmentation, normalization and n-gram matching
description: A PostgreSQL text search parser, dictionaries and configurations for names and short text in any script. ICU word boundaries split Chinese, Japanese, Thai and other unspaced scripts into words; a normalizing dictionary folds character widths, accents and apostrophes; an n-gram dictionary matches words inside Korean and CJK compounds.
